name: cadence
description: A disciplined workflow plugin for Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, and other SKILL.md runtimes: propose, investigate, implement, review, verify, ship, and reflect.

interface.shortDescription: Engineering workflow guardrails and stack conventions for Codex.
interface.longDescription: Cadence packages durable engineering rules and workflow modes for Codex. Command primers are exposed as cadence-* skills (for example cadence-plan, cadence-verify, cadence-ship).
defaultPrompt: Use cadence-plan to decompose this change.
Use cadence-verify and cadence-ship on this branch.
